Phil's current proptech sales role and enterprise SaaS background map directly; the only trade-off is a lower base than some senior AE roles.

jobs.title: Account Executive - B2B SaaS
jobs.fit_note: Direct continuation of Phil's proptech and full-cycle AE experience. Houseful sells software and data into the UK residential property market, so his Alto market knowledge, SaaS closing record and housing-sector credibility are unusually relevant.

jobs.title: CoStar Real Estate Manager, Sales Executive
jobs.fit_note: Strong enterprise proptech fit selling lease-administration and property-management software. Phil has the complex SaaS sales, stakeholder management and UK property context required; corporate real-estate buyers are a new segment but highly transferable.

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.fit_note: Highly relevant commercial role at a rental-focused property technology business. Phil combines B2B SaaS sales, direct property-sector experience and first-hand understanding of landlords and rental operations.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.fit_note: Strong match for outbound and consultative selling of property-data software. Phil's property-market knowledge and full-cycle SaaS track record fit well, although the role may lean more heavily towards high-velocity new business than enterprise account growth.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive
jobs.fit_note: Excellent bridge between SaaS and accommodation. The role sells hotel-commerce technology to property owners across the UK and Europe, matching Phil's prospecting skills and personal interest in Airbnb operations. The advertised seniority appears below his current level.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.fit_note: Strong account-growth and stakeholder-management fit within a tenant-experience proptech platform. Phil's enterprise relationship skills transfer well; this is more account management and adoption focused than his recent new-business AE work.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Matterport
jobs.fit_note: Strong fit selling visual property technology with a recognisable SaaS-style commercial motion. Phil's enterprise closing experience and property background are relevant; Manchester location is the main practical consideration.

jobs.title: Telephone Business Development Consultant, OnTheMarket
jobs.fit_note: Direct UK estate-agency market relevance and a clear fit with Phil's prospecting and property-software experience. It may be more telephone-led and junior than his ideal next move, but the employer and buyer set are highly aligned.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.fit_note: Good commercial crossover into a hospitality-led property operator. The role owns account growth, tours, demos and corporate relationships, using Phil's sales and stakeholder skills while moving closer to the accommodation and operating side of property.

jobs.title: Sales Executive - Private Rental
jobs.fit_note: Relevant rental-market sales role at a property marketplace, with a strong connection to Phil's landlord and proptech experience. Location and potentially more transactional sales scope make it a secondary option.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager
jobs.fit_note: Useful route into hands-on property management: leasing, reservations, occupancy, resident retention and service recovery. Phil's Airbnb hosting and people-management experience help, but direct build-to-rent operations and tenancy administration would be a learning curve.

jobs.title: Residence Manager
jobs.fit_note: Relevant operator-side role managing an accommodation asset, customer experience and commercial performance. Phil brings hospitality leadership from Japan and Airbnb-host perspective, though student-accommodation operations are not his direct background.

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.fit_note: Commercial role inside a large accommodation operator, offering exposure to property operations and occupancy growth. Phil is more senior than the advertised level and Liverpool may be impractical, so this is best treated as a sector-entry fallback.
